about: Static props of the story prologue (docs/STORY.md, Prolog im Detail): 12 kit modules, 21 set pieces and the mothership exterior. Each gets one Gemini picture (tools/meshy/prop_pictures.py) and then one Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D run (smart-topology, target_polycount as listed, 2k PBR textures). Machines are never props: clamps, racks, cradles and stations are shown empty, the robots in them are the game's own models. size_m is [width, depth, height] in metres as placed in the level.
meshy_note: Meshy refuses remove_lighting with Smart Topology and uses origin_at only with auto_size (docs.meshy.ai, 2026-11-20), so neither is sent; tools/blender/prop_pack.py sets the origin and the size.
refs_note: Reference pictures are prologue scene pictures from the story board (docs/story/images), given to Gemini only for mood, materials and wear; the prompt forbids copying any robot from them.
style: Industrial machine part from the 1999 RTS Machines, remade: worn red paint (RGB 0.70/0.09/0.07) on dark grey steel (sRGB 60-80), chipped edges and some dust, no large rust patches; yellow-black hazard stripes where red meets black; panels as raised bolted plates with thick edges, seams as deep grooves, vents as recessed slats; ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body; black lamp discs with a yellow glass; screens dark and blank; chunky, low-detail silhouette that reads from 10 m; single object on pure white, 3/4 view from slightly above, even light, no text, no logos.
geometry: All detail is real geometry, never painted on: plates are raised separate pieces with thick edges and bolt heads, seams are deep grooves, vents and grilles are recessed slats you can see into, hoses stand off the surface. Only colour stripes and hazard stripes are paint. Round parts (drums, domes, discs, rings, columns) are truly round, smooth circles and not six- or eight-sided. Wear stays moderate: chipped paint on edges and some dust, no large rubbed-off or rusted patches.
kit_style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
ribbed hoses only where the description names one, lying inside the tile's box and never on a walking surface or across an edge
kit_rule: This is a modular level-kit tile for a grid-based level: a SEAMLESS, straight-edged, box-shaped module. Its outer faces are flat and cut square at exact right angles, so copies of it fit edge to edge on a 1 metre grid without gaps; nothing sticks out past its rectangular box, every hose, pipe or cable stays inside that box, and the edges where it meets the next tile are clean, flat and straight (no bevelled or rounded outer silhouette, no broken or torn ends). Shown alone in a 3/4 view from slightly above so the top, the front and one side are visible.

props.name: kit_floor
props.description: Heavy deck floor plate of a spaceship maintenance hangar: a square, flat slab made of four bolted steel slabs with deep grooves between them, a recessed drain grille in one corner, a worn yellow-black edge stripe along one side.

props.name: kit_floor_grate
props.description: Open steel grating floor panel, a square flat panel. The red frame is ONE continuous solid rectangular ring with flush, perfectly straight outer edges and mitred corners, no separate blocks. Inside it is a heavy bar grating of 8 x 8 thick flat steel bars with wide square gaps you can see through. Two cross beams underneath, inside the frame.

props.name: kit_wall
props.description: Tall bulkhead wall section, a thick upright rectangular slab exactly twice as tall as it is wide, like two 4 m squares stacked: red armour plates with thick bolted edges fill the lower square, dark steel ribs fill the upper square, a horizontal ribbed hose runs straight across the full width at the middle of the upper square, a recessed vent slat panel near the floor. Portrait framing: the slab fills 80 % of the picture's height.

props.name: kit_wall_low
props.description: Short square bulkhead wall section for low rooms and ducts, a thick square slab: dark steel with one raised red plate, recessed slats, pipe brackets.

props.name: kit_pillar
props.description: A very slender square structural pillar, eight times as tall as it is wide, like eight cubes stacked, with chamfered vertical edges: a closed flat steel cap on top and a closed flat bottom, a red lower third, a yellow-black hazard stripe band near the bottom, chunky cable clamps, a small round black lamp disc halfway up that is no wider than half the pillar's face. Portrait framing: the pillar fills 85 % of the picture's height.

props.name: kit_ceiling
props.description: Square ceiling panel, shown lying flat on the ground with its beam side facing up, seen in a 3/4 view from above: two heavy steel I-beams run across it and end exactly flush with the slab's edges, dark steel plates between them, a cable tray along one beam whose cables end 10 cm inside the edge and never leave the slab, one rectangular light fixture set into the plates, switched off (dark glass). The slab's outer edge is one straight, flat, square band. It rests on the ground, it does not float.
props.note: The picture shows the underside facing up; the fit pass turns it over.

props.name: kit_door_frame
props.description: Heavy blast-door frame, a thick rectangular wall block with a large rectangular doorway cut through it: thick red armoured surround with yellow-black hazard stripes on the jambs, two hydraulic pistons on the sides, a warning lamp above, the opening empty (no door leaf), so you can see through it.

props.name: kit_door_leaf
props.description: One half of a sliding blast door, a tall thick rectangular slab standing upright: dark steel with raised bolted red plates, a diagonal yellow-black hazard stripe along its straight meeting edge, deep horizontal grooves.

props.name: kit_door_small
props.description: Small service door for maintenance robots set in a square wall block. The outer outline is one exact square block with flat, straight sides and top; the frame is one solid red piece. ONE single closed dark steel sliding leaf with raised bolted plates and deep horizontal grooves, and a dark horizontal viewing slit with no glass; beside it a keypad of 3 x 3 chunky blank square buttons with no screen and no symbols.

props.name: kit_duct
props.description: Straight square maintenance duct segment, a rectangular tunnel box open at both ends so you can look through it: riveted dark steel walls, internal ribs every metre, a ribbed hose running along the inside of the ceiling, a scuffed floor; both open ends cut flat and square.

props.name: kit_vent_cover
props.description: Wall vent cover, a flat rectangular panel standing upright: thick red frame with a heavy dark steel slat grille, one corner of the grille bent outward as if kicked open while the frame stays straight and square.

props.name: kit_grate_wall
props.description: Grate wall panel between corridors, a square flat panel standing upright: red frame, vertical steel bars with a diagonal cross brace, see-through.

props.name: clamp
props.description: Maintenance clamp gantry that holds a small spider robot in the air: exactly two heavy red C-shaped arms, mirror images of each other, hanging from a ceiling hoist block, with hydraulic pistons; two thick ribbed hoses run from the hoist block down into each arm. No floor ring and no thin cables: nothing stands below the arms. Empty: no robot in it. Seen in a 3/4 view from slightly above so the hoist block's top face is visible.

props.name: clamp_terminal
props.description: Small upright clamp status terminal: red steel case on a post, slanted blank black screen, three chunky buttons, a cable hose into the floor.

props.name: core
props.description: Giant ship computer core: a tall round column of stacked dark steel rings with dark blank slots, red armour bands with hazard stripes, many ribbed hoses arching from the top down into the floor, a heavy round base plinth. Truly round.

props.name: core_console
props.description: Operator console at the foot of a computer: a wide red steel desk with a slanted row of blank black screens, chunky switches, a probe socket port, hoses into the floor.

props.name: wall_screen
props.description: Wall-mounted monitor in a thick red bezel with bolts, a blank black screen, a cable hose from the bottom.

props.name: crate_small
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
props.description: Small cube cargo crate: dark steel box with red corner guards, raised bolted plates, a hazard stripe, two lifting lugs on top. Nothing sticks out of the cube except the two lifting lugs on top.

props.name: crate_large
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
props.description: Large cargo crate used as cover: a long dark steel container, red reinforced corners, a hinged lid with clamps, recessed handles. Nothing sticks out of the box: it stacks flat.

props.name: barrel
props.description: Coolant canister: a round red steel drum with two raised ribs, a yellow-black band, a valve and a short hose on top. Round.

props.name: weapon_rack
props.description: Wall weapon rack for robot arm weapons: a dark steel frame with red mounting clamps and a hazard-striped lower panel. All mounts empty: no weapons, no guns on it.

props.name: repair_station
props.description: Photorealistic 3D render, not an illustration, no outlines. Robot repair station: a round floor platform with a red hazard-striped ring, two articulated welding arms on a pillar, thick ribbed hoses, a lamp on a short thick red arm bolted to the top of the pillar (nothing hangs from above the picture), a black blank status screen. Only thick ribbed hoses, no thin cables. Empty: no robot on it.

props.name: generator
props.description: Power generator block: a heavy dark steel housing with red end caps, cooling fins as recessed slats, two thick ribbed hoses, a warning lamp on top.

props.name: junction_box
props.description: Wall junction box: a red steel cabinet with a bolted door and a chunky lever on its side; two thick ribbed hoses, each as thick as a fist, leave its underside and run straight down. No thin cables, no straps, nothing loose or dangling.

props.name: lamp_emergency
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
black lamp discs with a yellow glass
props.description: Wall emergency lamp: a shallow round black disc lamp, its depth a third of its diameter, with an opaque frosted red glass face behind four thick crossed steel bars, on a flat red steel wall plate bigger than the lamp. The back of the plate is flat; the whole part sticks out no more than 0.4 m from the wall.

props.name: alarm_beacon
props.description: Rotating alarm beacon: a red steel base, a round amber glass dome in a protective cage. Round.

props.name: pa_speaker
props.description: Ship announcement loudspeaker: a square horn speaker in dark steel on a red bracket, a cable hose.

props.name: pipe_run
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
the one ribbed hose runs straight beside the pipes
props.description: Wall pipe run mounted flat against a wall (its back is flat and vertical): three thick straight parallel pipes and one ribbed corrugated hose run horizontally across the full 4 m and end cut flat and flush at both ends, so the next run continues them; two red wall brackets hold them; one valve wheel on the middle pipe. No pump, no box, no elbows, nothing open. The whole run fits in the picture with a wide white margin on every side: the backing plate, the three pipes and the hose all end together at the same two vertical lines, each pipe end a flat closed cap flush with the plate's edge.

props.name: cable_hang
props.description: Three thick ribbed hoses, each as thick as an arm, hanging in deep U-shaped loops from a solid steel ceiling bracket beam. The hoses are round tubes with clear ribs, not flat straps; no thin cables, nothing frayed.

props.name: pod_cradle
props.description: Launch cradle for an escape pod: a heavy round red ring frame with four hydraulic clamp arms over an open round floor hatch, hazard stripes around the hatch, hoses. Empty: no pod in it.

props.name: bay_crane
props.description: Overhead gantry crane for a hangar, on a short section of its two rails: a long dark steel bridge beam with red end trucks on the rails, a hook block hanging on chains, warning lamps. Nothing on the hook.

props.name: debris_beam
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
two short thick hoses dangling from the tear
black lamp discs with a yellow glass; screens dark and blank;
props.description: A fallen steel I-beam lying on its side with the web horizontal, bent clearly at the middle into a shallow V of about 30 degrees, as after an explosion; torn red plating hangs off it; two short thick hoses dangle from the tear. Wreckage only: no lamps, no vents, no screens. Seen from its end, its cross-section looks like a capital letter H: the two flanges stand upright like low walls and the web is a flat horizontal plate between them at mid-height. No louvres, no vent slats.

props.name: debris_panel
props.description: A torn hull panel: a bent red armour plate ripped from a wall, jagged edges, broken bolts, one scorched side.

props.name: mothership
style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
props.description: Huge blocky industrial seeding mothership, a starship that flies in space and never lands, seen whole as a scale model: a long tapered hull of dark grey steel, red only as bands and markings on about a fifth of the surface. Shown in a 3/4 view slightly from below so the flat underside with its rows of recessed square pod hatches is visible. The bow is closed and blunt; the only engine is the heavy block at the stern. Cranes and antenna masts on the back are short and thick, no thin wires. No glow, no flames, no engine fire. No wheels, no tracks, no legs, no landing gear: it is not a vehicle or a train. Exactly ONE ship, shown once: no second copy, no reflection, no fade. The cranes hold their hooks on thick rigid arms, with no cables.
props.note: Seen only from far in the Abwurf; size is a guess (about 1.2 km long), the board asset is a-mutterschiff.

props.name: pod_drop
props.description: The escape pod as it drops (the Abwurf cutscene): the player's own Meshy model (Crimson Spike Pod, 2026-11-23, FBX converted by Claude to model.glb), legs drawn in, four spikes on its dark cap.
props.note: Not made from this plan: the player made it in Meshy. Size: the HD Pod 1 (the player's Crimson Spike Fortress in the rig) is 41.4 m tall with its spikes, and this one is drawn at the same scale.
